# Upright

> Upright is a free, open-source (MIT) macOS menu-bar app that remaps the buttons on Logitech mice without Logi Options+. It talks to the mouse directly over Logitech's HID++ protocol: gestures, per-app profiles, pointer speed (DPI) presets and battery alerts, with no account, no analytics and no background daemon. Made by Basalt Studio (https://hellobasalt.dev/).

Requirements: macOS 13 or later, Apple silicon and Intel. Verified on real hardware with the Logitech MX Vertical (USB cable and Unifying receiver; Bluetooth is best effort). Other Logitech mice that speak HID++ 2.0 with programmable buttons (MX Master, MX Anywhere, MX Ergo and Lift families) are expected to work but are not verified yet. Logitech mice only.

Nothing is written to the mouse: buttons are diverted only while Upright runs, and quitting it restores factory behaviour. Quit Logi Options+, Solaar or LogiOps while using it, since only one app can divert the buttons. It asks for Accessibility to send shortcuts and clicks, and Input Monitoring only if macOS hides a Bluetooth mouse.

## Pages

- [Upright home](https://upright.hellobasalt.dev/): what it does, download, and FAQ
- [Logi Options+ alternatives for Mac](https://upright.hellobasalt.dev/logi-options-alternatives): Upright, BetterMouse, Mac Mouse Fix, SteerMouse and LinearMouse compared on price, Logitech buttons and privacy
- [MX Vertical on Mac without Logi Options+](https://upright.hellobasalt.dev/mx-vertical): remapping the MX Vertical's top (DPI), back, forward and wheel buttons
- [Privacy](https://upright.hellobasalt.dev/privacy): Upright collects nothing
- [Terms](https://upright.hellobasalt.dev/terms): MIT License, provided as is

- [Source code](https://github.com/dpdev69/upright): build with Xcode 15.3 or later, no Apple Developer account needed
